cohort: 120 women, including 30 with placenta praevia, 30 with placenta accreta spectrum disorders, and 60 matched controls (30 for each condition) based on age, gestational age, and BMI.
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) patients exhibited statistically significant higher mean ProBNP and troponin I levels compared to their matched controls, with troponin I showing a stronger association for identifying PAS and adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes.
